summary: Security reviewers get an up-to-date pack with every release.

new.title: Security pack with every release
new.text: Reviewers now get a security pack with each release: architecture, identities, every permission and why, data, vendor access, hardening and more. It always matches the version you run.

fixes.title: Documentation describes policy stage moves correctly
fixes.text: The documentation now says the suite can make one change to a Conditional Access policy: a SuperAdmin moves it to another stage after approval. The permission for it is listed.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes: outdated install description removed
fixes.text: The install description no longer mentions a custom role that newer installs do not create.
